header_first_lines: # CASMI legacy FP and ranker reproducibility

This packet releases the recovered preparation, FPNet, S2/M1 training and ranker source, with exact retained artifact hashes and the gaps in historical reproducibility stated explicitly. It contains source and aggregate evidence; it contains no competition records, candidate structures, role assignments or weights.

header_first_lines: "schema": "casmi-legacy-artifact-bindings/1",
CASMI legacy 6930-bit preparation and training source

This release supplies the original preparation, FPNet, trainers and 31-column ranker builder, plus two clearly marked reconstructed export steps. No historical training or ranking assay was rerun to prepare this release. The retained checkpoint bytes and source recipes are bound separately; the launch commands alone do not prove which run produced a particular checkpoint.

existing_notice_or_attribution_matches.text: OBSERVED_LEGACY_ARTIFACT_BINDINGS.json supplies exact byte lengths and SHA256 for the current retained old train, September2026 COCONUT CSV, intermediate arrays and outputs. These are observed local byte pins, not a signed upstream release checksum or a historical build attestation. In particular, the later current train.parquet has different bytes and rows; it must not silently substitute for the pinned legacy train. COCONUT must supply canonical_smiles, molecular_formula and np_likeness. The source normalizes the largest fragment and filters molecule size, charge and mass before sorting np_likeness and deduplicating connectivity keys. Rights and original source attribution are in the dataset cards; this source release does not redistribute spectra or third-party databases.
